root.label: Judge Stanley Bastian reinstates Roger Rogoff as U.S. attorney

events.label: Judge Stanley Bastian reinstates Roger Rogoff as U.S. attorney

slots.name: employment status
slots.sentence: On Thursday, U.S. District Court Judge Stanley Bastian issued a preliminary injunction and reinstated Rogoff as U.S. attorney.

slots.name: appointment date
slots.sentence: Bastian ruled Rogoff has been the "rightful" U.S. attorney in the Western District of Washington since July 15, when federal district judges in the region appointed him and he took the oath of office.
